cases.title: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476) - Fully Compliant Authorization

fields.section_b_membership_type: College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)

narrative_blocks: Applicant Jane Doe appoints Marcus Vance (CICC License #R512398) as her designated paid representative for her permanent residence application.
All required sections of Form IMM 5476 (09-2023 edition) have been completed in full. Signatures from both applicant Jane Doe and representative Marcus Vance are executed with corresponding dates.
CICC membership status verified as active and in good standing with no regulatory restrictions.

cases.title: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476) - Missing Applicant and Representative Signatures

fields.section_b_membership_type: College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)

narrative_blocks: Submission of IMM 5476 submitted on behalf of applicant John Smith with designated representative Eleanor Vance.
Review of Section B (Question 9) and Section E (Question 12) reveals that required signatures are entirely absent from both the representative and applicant endorsement boxes.
Procedural Fairness Letter (PFL) triggered due to incomplete evidence and unvalidated legal authorization.

defect_spec.description: The IMM 5476 form lacks mandatory signatures from the representative in Section B (Question 9), the primary applicant in Section E (Question 12), and accompanying dependent signature box.

cases.title: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476) - Unaccredited Paid Representative Missing CICC ID

fields.section_b_membership_type: College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC)

narrative_blocks: Applicant Carlos Gomez submitted Form IMM 5476 appointing Arthur Pendelton of Global Mobility Services Inc. as a paid representative.
Section B indicates financial compensation was received; however, the CICC/Law Society membership license number is missing and verification with CICC public registry indicates no active license.
Procedural Fairness Letter issued due to representation by an unauthorized paid representative in violation of IRPA Section 91.

defect_spec.description: Representative Arthur Pendelton is designated as a paid representative in Section B Question 7 but failed to provide a valid CICC or Law Society membership identifier, violating authorization requirements.
affected_fields: Section B - Question 7 (Paid/Unpaid Status and Membership ID Number)

mutation_details.licensing_verification_status: Unaccredited / Not found in CICC database

cases.title: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476) - Submission of Outdated Form Version
narrative_blocks: Applicant Elena Rostova submitted IMM 5476 dated 2024-01-10 using the (06-2015) edition of the form.
The submitted form references decommissioned regulatory bodies (CSIC) and lacks current statutory consent clauses and CICC designated body identifiers mandated in current revisions.
Submission rejected as invalid due to outdated form edition version.

defect_spec.description: Form version submitted is edition (06-2015) E which lacks required statutory disclosures, modern CICC designated body identifier fields, and current Section E authorization clauses.
affected_fields: Section B - Designated Body Identifier Fields

cases.title: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476) - Undeclared Ghost Representative Misrepresentation

fields.portal_account_credentials_owner: Apex Immigration Consulting Inc. (Shared Agency Portal)

narrative_blocks: Applicant Amina Al-Mansoor submitted an e-APR claiming self-representation with no IMM 5476 form attached.
Audit of portal metadata and Section A contact information reveals portal access, email contact, and payment originate from Apex Immigration Consulting Inc.
Procedural Fairness Letter issued under IRPA A40(1)(a) for misrepresentation due to undeclared paid representative / ghost consultant.

defect_spec.description: The application claims self-representation while technical metadata and Section A contact details confirm an undisclosed paid ghost consultant managed and submitted the application.
affected_fields: e-APR Portal Account Credentials & IP Metadata

mutation_details.contact_email_mismatch: Applicant email replaced by agency email contact@apeximmigrationconsulting.example.com
